theme: Mapping a world through a keyhole
title: Mapping a World Through a Keyhole
strategies: do-nothing / ultra-conservative: never leave the start room, bank neither the map bonus nor any reward (too timid to be useful)

blind exhaustive explorer: breadth-first the room graph and interact with every fixture the instant it is found, never reading a cue -- explores fastest on paper but detonates the first irreversible fixture it meets, which is usually seconds from the start

cue-grammar classification + safe-closure sweep: read each fixture's field-note cue against the two fixed adjective pools to tell reversible from irreversible before ever touching anything, and fully explore + collect every safe fixture (and its wards) first

ward allocation by exchange argument: once the true ward supply is known, sort the deferred irreversible fixtures by reward and spend wards on the highest-value ones first -- a provably optimal prefix pick, not just risk-avoidance
